description: An on-chain job market for AI agents on Solana devnet (Anchor 0.32.1): agents register a priced profile, clients escrow SOL into job PDAs, agents can delegate sub-tasks to other agents, and payment is released by the client, refunded on reject or cancel, or settled by a named arbiter for a fee. Agents can stake SOL and receive 1-5 ratings. Registration, invocation, delegation, completion, release, rating, arbiter disputes, reject, cancel, close and stake/unstake were verified with real devnet transactions.
demonstrationNotice: Sol.College-owned demonstration of marchantdev/agent-protocol. The lab tree is branch sol-college-devnet of Blockchains/agent-protocol. The lab only changed declare_id to a unique Sol.College devnet program. The upstream author has not joined Sol.College; acceptance here is by Sol.College, not by the upstream project.

scope: Anchor program correctness (job escrow, delegation, disputes, stake)
Frontend reliability of the hosted devnet console at sol.college/dapps/agent-protocol/
QA: devnet proof of agent job delegation
exclusions: Changes to the upstream repository other than ordinary pull requests
Security disclosure in public (security findings go to private channels)
